result.informal_name: Quadratic Map Applied to Sum Decomposition
result.informal_description: For a quadratic map $ Q : M \to N $, a finite set $ s $ of indices, and a function $ f : \iota \to M $, the value of $ Q $ at the sum $ \sum_{i \in s} f(i) $ equals the sum $ \sum_{i \in s} Q(f(i)) $ plus the sum over all unordered pairs $ \{i,j\} \in \mathrm{Sym}^2(s) $ with $ i \neq j $ of the polar form $ B(f(i),f(j)) $. Formally: $ Q\left(\sum_{i \in s} f(i)\right) = \sum_{i \in s} Q(f(i)) + \sum_{\substack{\{i,j\} \in \mathrm{Sym}^2(s) \\ i \neq j}} B(f(i),f(j)) $.

result.informal_name: Equality of Double Sums Over Upper Triangular and Off-Diagonal Pairs
result.informal_description: For any finite linearly ordered type $\alpha$ with locally finite order top and bottom, and any additive commutative monoid $M$, the double sum over all $i \in \alpha$ and $j > i$ of $f(j, i) + f(i, j)$ equals the double sum over all $i \in \alpha$ and $j \neq i$ of $f(j, i)$.

result.value:
:= by
  by_cases h : r < -1
  · -- case `r < -1`
    
    simp only [h, iff_true]
    exact (Real.summable_nat_rpow.mpr h).subtype _
  · -- case `-1 ≤ r`
    
    simp only [h, iff_false]
    refine fun H ↦ Nat.Primes.not_summable_one_div <| H.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ by positivity) ?_
    intro p
    rw [one_div, ← Real.rpow_neg_one]

result.informal_name: Summability of Prime Powers: $\sum p^r$ Converges iff $r < -1$
result.informal_description: The infinite series formed by summing $ p^r $ over all prime numbers $ p $ is summable (i.e., converges) if and only if the real number $ r $ is less than $ -1 $.

name: riemannZeta_eulerProduct_exp_log
result.signature: {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : exp (∑' p : Nat.Primes, -Complex.log (1 - p ^ (-s))) = riemannZeta s
result.type: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 1 < s.re → Complex.exp (∑' (p : Nat.Primes), -Complex.log (1 - ↑↑p ^ (-s))) = riemannZeta s
result.informal_name: Euler Product Formula for the Riemann Zeta Function via Exponential of Prime Logarithms
result.informal_description: For any complex number $ s $ with $ \operatorname{Re}(s) > 1 $, the exponential of the sum over all prime numbers $ p $ of $ -\log(1 - p^{-s}) $ equals the Riemann zeta function $ \zeta(s) $. That is, $ \exp\left(\sum_{p \in \mathbb{P}} -\log(1 - p^{-s})\right) = \zeta(s) $.
